# HAPI v0.25.1.3

Compared with the previous maintained release, this build expands the maintained PR set with runner version governance, Cursor and Claude session import, structured session patches, model-picker fixes, quote selection, scratchlist attachment migration, share-target session search, tool grouping, and related UI fixes.

Compared with the official release, it carries PRs #1108, #945, #897, #947, #658, #986, #1212, #1227, #1157, #1158, #1147, #988, and #978, in addition to the maintained changes from v0.25.1.2.
